findings.title: Category fabricators overwritten by embeddable_host fabricator
findings.body: This file previously defined :category, :diff_category, :happy_category and :private_category. The diff replaces all of them with the :embeddable_host fabricator. The same category fabricators are re-added in spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb, so the two files look swapped. Fabricator loading may still work, but :embeddable_host is now defined in two places and the file names no longer match their contents. Any load-order or duplicate-definition problem would break most of the test suite.

findings.title: Migration crashes when embed_category setting row is absent
findings.body: The query `execute(...)[0]['id']` indexes the first row of the result. On a default install there is no `embed_category` row in site_settings (the default was ''), so the result is empty and `[0]` is nil. `nil['id']` raises NoMethodError and the migration fails. The `category_id == 0` fallback below it is never reached. The uncategorized_category_id lookup on line 15 has the same problem if that row is missing.

findings.title: Unescaped SQL interpolation and unnormalized hosts in migration
findings.body: Host values from the old setting are interpolated directly into the INSERT statement with no quoting. A value containing a single quote breaks the migration, and it is also an injection vector. The values are also not stripped of http(s):// or trailing whitespace, so old entries such as 'http://eviltrout.com' are stored as-is. The model normalizes hosts only on validation, so these migrated rows would never match in `host_allowed?`. The migration also uses `change` with irreversible deletes and data work.

findings.title: Host lookup is case-inconsistent and breaks on uri.host being nil
findings.body: The query compares `lower(host)` with the unlowered `uri.host`. URI normally downcases the host, but stored values are not downcased on save and `lower(host)` is only applied to the column. `record_for_host` returns `false` rather than nil on failure, which is inconsistent. Hosts with ports are stored with the port (the validation regex allows it) but are compared against `uri.host`, which has no port, so those entries never match.

findings.title: before_validation mutates nil/frozen host
findings.body: `self.host.sub!` raises NoMethodError when host is nil, for example when the params key is missing. It also mutates the string in place. The controller reads `params[:embeddable_host][:host]`, so a request without a host gives a 500 error instead of a validation error.

findings.title: Nil host record on update/destroy yields 500
findings.body: `EmbeddableHost.where(id: ...).first` returns nil for an unknown id. `save_host(nil)` and `host.destroy` then raise NoMethodError, producing a 500 where a 404 would be correct. Use `find`, or return a not-found response.

findings.title: update action is a no-op
findings.body: `update` ignores its params and just re-renders the embedding. The client's `saveChanges` calls it with an empty hash, so nothing is persisted.

findings.title: Save sends 'host' key and sets category from client lookup
findings.body: `getProperties('host')` on the buffer returns `{host: ...}`, and `host.save(props)` is then called with it. The component's buffer is also not committed back to the model on success, so the displayed host text stays stale after an edit. The category is set from `Discourse.Category.findById` instead of from the server response.

findings.title: replace only swaps first underscore
findings.body: `type.replace('_', '-')` with a string pattern replaces only the first underscore. A type name with more than one underscore would not match ADMIN_MODELS.
